notes: בְּאַחַת → 'together' is taken as a rule 30 fusion headed on אַחַת; splitting it would leave one morpheme unrepresented with no English word of its own.
The restrictive 'but' of 'it is but a stock' is added: עֵץ הוּא holds no particle answering to it, and the word is written beside the renderings rather than inside one of them (rules 30, 51).
